description.narrative: Supports the following illustrative program-funded costs: salaries of US, FSN, and TCN and other staff such as PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs working for the US Government managing, administering, and supporting programs and their program-funded benefits such as housing, travel, transportation, education allowances etc; institutional contractors that provide such staff, rent, IT services, the program-funded share of utilities, staff training costs and the cost of developing and administering training programs, equipment and supplies, ICASS, vehicle fuel and maintenance, maintenance contracts, janitorial services, operational unit web page development and maintenance, outreach such as publications and the cost of their preparation (including staff costs), and technical assistance to ensure USG compliance with regulations.

Respalda los siguientes costos ilustrativos financiados por programas: salarios de EE. UU., FSN y TCN y otro personal como PSC, RSSA, PASA, CASU que trabajan para el gobierno de EE. UU. que gestionan, administran y apoyan programas y sus beneficios financiados por programas, como vivienda, viajes, transporte, asignaciones educativas, etc.; contratistas institucionales que proporcionan dicho personal, alquiler, servicios de TI, la parte financiada por el programa de los servicios públicos, costos de capacitación del personal y el costo de desarrollar y administrar programas, equipos y suministros de capacitación, ICASS, combustible y mantenimiento de vehículos, contratos de mantenimiento, servicios de limpieza, desarrollo y mantenimiento de la página web de la unidad operativa, divulgación como publicaciones y el costo de su preparación (incluidos los costos de personal) y asistencia técnica para garantizar el cumplimiento de las regulaciones del Gobierno de los Estados Unidos.

title.narrative: Civic Participation - Civil Society Legal and Regulatory Frameworks

description.narrative: Civic Participation - Establish legal and regulatory frameworks that protect and promote civil society and civic participation. This includes but is not limited to ensuring that frameworks are in place that enable CSOs to form and operate freely (e.g., NGO registration/incorporation laws, laws protecting freedom of association and collective bargaining), promoting the sustainability of the civil society sector (e.g., tax benefits for NGOs), and supporting public participation and social accountability (e.g., public hearings, instructional seminars, and conferences). This aspect also includes strengthening advocacy, networking, grassroots coalitions, and public support for reforms related to the enabling environment.

title.narrative: Civic Participation - Civil Society Capacity for Democratic Processes

description.narrative: Civic Participation - Strengthen the capacity of CSOs for policy analysis, advocacy, coalition-building, internal governance, membership representation and services, and engage in other activities aimed at fostering more peaceful and democratic societies. CSOs include, but are not limited to, human rights organizations, womens groups, labor unions, business and professional associations, youth movements, religious organizations, indigenous organizations, think tanks, and organizations representing vulnerable populations. Areas of capacity building may include, but are not limited to, technical expertise (e.g. human rights, legal reform); CSO self-regulation (e.g. establishing NGO Codes of Conduct); organizational capacity (e.g. strategic planning, financial management and accountability, public relations, issue management, and outreach, revenue generation, accountable fundraising); and targeted advocacy training and technical assistance.

title.narrative: Accounting/Certified International Professional Accountant Project (ACIPA) - Central Asia

description.narrative: The goal of the two-year ACIPA project was to strengthen local institutions in their capacity to advance the accounting profession and support the transition to a full market economy well-after USAID phases out its assistance in this sector. These institutions included Higher Educational Institutions (HEIs) and their incorporation of modern accounting curricula, Country Offices of the CIPA Examination Network, the regional Eurasian Council of Certified Accountants and Auditors and its country-level member accounting associations whom together form the institutional structure to educate and advocate for professional accounting practices and standards in the region.

description.narrative: Program Design and Learning - Develop and conduct needs assessments, baseline studies, targeted evaluations, special studies or other information-gathering efforts specifically for the design, monitoring and evaluation of USG-funded operating unit wide programs, not for a specific functional objective. This sub-element may also include developing and disseminating best practices and lessons learned, testing demonstration and/or pilot models, public outreach, or the preparation of strategic plans and other short-term programming tasks. Funding for similar activities that are directed to specific functional objectives should be entered in the PD&L sub-element of the appropriate program area(s) within that objective.

description.narrative: Supports the following illustrative program-funded costs: salaries of US, FSN, and TCN and other staff such as PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs working for the US Government managing, administering, and supporting programs and their program-funded benefits such as housing, travel, transportation, education allowances etc; institutional contractors that provide such staff, rent, IT services, the program-funded share of utilities, staff training costs and the cost of developing and administering training programs, equipment and supplies, ICASS, vehicle fuel and maintenance, maintenance contracts, janitorial services, operational unit web page development and maintenance, outreach such as publications and the cost of their preparation (including staff costs), and technical assistance to ensure USG compliance with regulations.

Respalda los siguientes costos ilustrativos financiados por programas: salarios de EE. UU., FSN y TCN y otro personal como PSC, RSSA, PASA, CASU que trabajan para el gobierno de EE. UU. que gestionan, administran y apoyan programas y sus beneficios financiados por programas, como vivienda, viajes, transporte, asignaciones educativas, etc.; contratistas institucionales que proporcionan dicho personal, alquiler, servicios de TI, la parte financiada por el programa de los servicios públicos, costos de capacitación del personal y el costo de desarrollar y administrar programas, equipos y suministros de capacitación, ICASS, combustible y mantenimiento de vehículos, contratos de mantenimiento, servicios de limpieza, desarrollo y mantenimiento de la página web de la unidad operativa, divulgación como publicaciones y el costo de su preparación (incluidos los costos de personal) y asistencia técnica para garantizar el cumplimiento de las regulaciones del Gobierno de los Estados Unidos.

description.narrative: Support to the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights

La evaluación es la recopilación y el análisis sistemático de información sobre las características y resultados de programas y proyectos como base para emitir juicios, mejorar la eficacia e informar las decisiones sobre la programación actual y futura. Las evaluaciones son distintas de (a) evaluaciones de necesidades, que están diseñadas para examinar el contexto del país o del sector para informar el diseño de proyectos, (b) revisiones internas informales de proyectos y (c) auditorías (realizadas internamente o por una audiencia externa). Estos esfuerzos no deberían incluirse en el PO.3. Sin embargo, las evaluaciones de evaluabilidad (aquellas evaluaciones realizadas con el propósito de determinar si se puede realizar o no una evaluación de una actividad) deben incluirse en el PO.3. Esta área programática debe incluir todas las evaluaciones diseñadas y financiadas con fondos de asistencia extranjera, incluidos los componentes de los contratos con órdenes de trabajo para las evaluaciones (independientemente del mecanismo). También debe incluir a todos los contratistas independientes contratados únicamente para producir evaluaciones; todos los demás contratistas (por ejemplo, aquellos cuyas responsabilidades laborales pueden incluir el apoyo o la gestión de la evaluación pero no la producción de una evaluación como entregable) deben incluirse en el PO.2

description.narrative: Improve the capacity and sustainability of civil and criminal justice sector actors and institutions, enhance coordination amongst them, develop citizen demand for an effective and accountable justice system, and develop associations to advocate for all citizens. Justice sector actors and institutions include: police, border security, prosecutors, forensics experts, judges, court personnel, public defenders, corrections personnel, private bar, law schools, legal professional associations, and training institutions for each of them. Work towards an equitable justice system by ensuring equality before the law, fair trial standards, and other elements of procedural fairness. Ensure more equitable access to justice through innovations within and beyond the state system and through improvements in the quality and quantity of justice services, with a particular focus on women, youth, the poor, and other marginalized or vulnerable groups. Programs primarily focused on trafficking in persons or migrant smuggling should be included in element 5.3 under the Transnational Crime area in the Peace and Security Objective.

Mejorar la capacidad y la sostenibilidad de los actores e instituciones del sector de justicia civil y penal, mejorar la coordinación entre ellos, desarrollar la demanda ciudadana de un sistema de justicia eficaz y responsable, y desarrollar asociaciones para defender a todos los ciudadanos. Los actores e instituciones del sector judicial incluyen: policía, seguridad fronteriza, fiscales, expertos forenses, jueces, personal judicial, defensores públicos, personal penitenciario, abogados privados, facultades de derecho, asociaciones profesionales jurídicas e instituciones de capacitación para cada uno de ellos. Trabajar por un sistema de justicia equitativo garantizando la igualdad ante la ley, estándares de juicio justo y otros elementos de equidad procesal. Garantizar un acceso más equitativo a la justicia mediante innovaciones dentro y fuera del sistema estatal y mediante mejoras en la calidad y cantidad de los servicios de justicia, con especial atención a las mujeres, los jóvenes, los pobres y otros grupos marginados o vulnerables. Los programas centrados principalmente en la trata de personas o el tráfico ilícito de migrantes deberían incluirse en el elemento 5.3 del área de Delincuencia Transnacional del Objetivo de Paz y Seguridad.

title.narrative: PAPA with Department of Interior - ITAP Partnership to End Wildlife Trafficking in East Africa

description.narrative: DOI-ITAP work in Sub-Saharan Africa has included protected areas management, tourism development, natural resource conservation program development, rural community engagement in natural resources conservation, land cover mapping, and groundwater resource monitoring. A major focal area is wildlife trafficking, which threatens the security, economy, and biodiversity of East Africa. To protect the regions wildlife in line with the US National Strategy for Combating Wildlife Trafficking, U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) Missions in East Africa have created the Partnership to End Wildlife Trafficking in East Africa with DOI-ITAP.

title.narrative: Inter-Agency Aggreement with U.S. Forest Service - Environment

description.narrative: This USAID Inter-Agency Agreement with the U.S. Forest Service will advance U.S. government technical assistance to support improved natural resource management. Kenya's five major Water Towers - Mau Forest Complex, Mt. Kenya, Aberdares, Cherangani Hills, and Mt. Elgon - provide an estimated 75 percent of the country's water resources and are central to Kenya's economic and social well-being. Despite their critical importance, the Water Tower ecosystems have been seriously degraded and continue to be negatively impacted by a number of activities, including ill-planned settlements, overgrazing, uncontrolled and illegal forest resource extraction, and the conversion of forest land to agriculture. The purpose of this activity is to reverse the effects of forests degradation; and to halt a growing water crisis, the loss of biodiversity and to decrease carbon emissions from land use change.

description.narrative: Promote peaceful agreement on democratic reform, rules, and frameworks. Promote peaceful, broad-based participation in determining, defining, and negotiating changes to governing structures. Illustrative examples include promoting inclusive consensus-building processes related to peace agreements, national dialogues, referenda on key issues, and constitutional development or reform. Programs are designed to incorporate and support mechanisms that advance conflict mediation, resolution and negotiation of disputes in the context of these processes.

description.narrative: Improve the capacity of businesses to integrate into domestic and international markets through increases in productivity and improvements in corporate governance and the development and application of modern technology and marketing practices. Enhance the capacity of businesses and business associations in terms of their corporate governance capabilities and their application of best practices and technologies to achieve increased production and marketing of products and services. It includes adoption of efficient production processes, improved labor productivity, environmentally-sound management of natural resources and the development of accounting and management systems that can help the company and industry group implement business, labor, product and process standards that enhance business competitiveness. Business capacity development programs may include activities that help men- and women-owned firms and associations respond to these international markets and create regional alliances.

Prend en charge les coûts indicatifs suivants financés par le programme : les salaires des États-Unis, du FSN et du TCN et d'autres membres du personnel tels que les PSC, les RSSA, les PASA et les CASU travaillant pour le gouvernement américain qui gèrent, administrent et soutiennent les programmes et leurs avantages financés par le programme tels que le logement, les voyages, le transport, les allocations d'études, etc. ; les entrepreneurs institutionnels qui fournissent ce personnel, le loyer, les services informatiques, la part des services publics financée par le programme, les coûts de formation du personnel et les coûts de développement et d'administration des programmes de formation, des équipements et des fournitures, l'ICASS, le carburant et l'entretien des véhicules, les contrats de maintenance, les services de conciergerie, le développement et la maintenance des pages Web des unités opérationnelles, la sensibilisation telle que les publications et le coût de leur préparation (y compris les coûts de personnel), et l'assistance technique pour garantir la conformité du gouvernement américain aux réglementations.

description.narrative: Strengthen the legal, regulatory, institutional, and information environment which protects and enables the growth in associational life and the development of independent and sustainable civil society organizations (CSOs). Build the capacity of civil society organizations to act as agents for reform and support their participation in democratic decision-making through articulating and representing their members interests, engaging in service delivery, and advocating for issues which become part of the public agenda and are reflected in public policies. Encourage the strengthening of a civic culture which supports democratic institutions and processes, active participation in political and civic life, and the civic virtues of tolerance, pluralism, compromise, trust, and respect for individual rights, including gender equality.

Renforcer l’environnement juridique, réglementaire, institutionnel et informationnel qui protège et permet la croissance de la vie associative et le développement d’organisations de la société civile (OSC) indépendantes et durables. Renforcer la capacité des organisations de la société civile à agir en tant qu'agents de réforme et à soutenir leur participation à la prise de décision démocratique en articulant et en représentant les intérêts de leurs membres, en s'engageant dans la prestation de services et en plaidant pour des questions qui font partie de l'agenda public et se reflètent dans les politiques publiques. Encourager le renforcement d'une culture civique qui soutient les institutions et processus démocratiques, la participation active à la vie politique et civique et les vertus civiques de tolérance, de pluralisme, de compromis, de confiance et de respect des droits individuels, y compris l'égalité des sexes.

description.narrative: Improve the capacity of businesses to integrate into domestic and international markets through increases in productivity and improvements in corporate governance and the development and application of modern technology and marketing practices. Enhance the capacity of businesses and business associations in terms of their corporate governance capabilities and their application of best practices and technologies to achieve increased production and marketing of products and services. It includes adoption of efficient production processes, improved labor productivity, environmentally-sound management of natural resources and the development of accounting and management systems that can help the company and industry group implement business, labor, product and process standards that enhance business competitiveness. Business capacity development programs may include activities that help men- and women-owned firms and associations respond to these international markets and create regional alliances.

Améliorer la capacité des entreprises à s'intégrer aux marchés nationaux et internationaux grâce à des augmentations de productivité et à des améliorations de la gouvernance d'entreprise ainsi qu'au développement et à l'application de technologies et de pratiques de marketing modernes. Renforcer la capacité des entreprises et des associations professionnelles en termes de capacités de gouvernance d'entreprise et d'application des meilleures pratiques et technologies pour accroître la production et la commercialisation de produits et de services. Cela comprend l'adoption de processus de production efficaces, une productivité du travail améliorée, une gestion écologiquement rationnelle des ressources naturelles et le développement de systèmes de comptabilité et de gestion qui peuvent aider l'entreprise et le groupe industriel à mettre en œuvre des normes commerciales, de travail, de produits et de processus qui améliorent la compétitivité des entreprises. Les programmes de développement des capacités des entreprises peuvent inclure des activités qui aident les entreprises et associations appartenant à des hommes et à des femmes à répondre à ces marchés internationaux et à créer des alliances régionales.

description.narrative: The Action for West Africa Region-HIV/AIDS (AWARE) project, dedicated to fighting HIV and AIDS in the region by disseminating best practices, building capacity of regional institutions and networks, promoting policy change and developing health-sector reform.

Le projet Action for West Africa Region-HIV/AIDS (AWARE), dédié à la lutte contre le VIH et le SIDA dans la région en diffusant les meilleures pratiques, en renforçant les capacités des institutions et des réseaux régionaux, en promouvant le changement de politique et en développant la réforme du secteur de la santé.

description.narrative: PMI will help the NMCP and national MIP working group to update its MIP guidelines and training materials to reflect the 2012 WHO IPTp policy recommendations. PMI will also help ANC providers at public (and selected private) facilities in the PMI targeted areas to deliver IPTp and LLINs effectively as part of routine ANC services. Activities will include in-service refresher training, job aides, and supportive supervision.

PMI aidera le PNLP et le groupe de travail national MIP à mettre à jour ses directives et matériels de formation MIP pour refléter les recommandations politiques de l'OMS sur le TPIp de 2012. PMI aidera également les prestataires de soins prénatals dans les établissements publics (et privés sélectionnés) des zones ciblées par PMI à fournir efficacement le TPIg et les MILD dans le cadre des services prénatals de routine. Les activités comprendront une formation de recyclage en cours d'emploi, des aides à l'emploi et une supervision formative.

description.narrative: The Research Technical Assistance Center (RTAC) is working to build a global network of university researchers to provide USAID with rapid, on-demand research expertise across all sectors and geographic areas. This technical assistance helps USAID Missions, Bureaus and Independent Offices (M/B/IO) make evidence-based decisions. NORC at the University of Chicago leads USAID's RTAC Consortia in establishing a network of university-based researchers. Their initial network is comprised of 254 faculty, graduate students, postdocs, and lecturers affiliated with 128 organizations that are available to support the scientific and research-based technical assistance needs for the Agency. This network is institutionally and individually diverse, drawing a significant percentage of participants from U.S. minority serving institutions and developing country universities and inclusive of a high percentage of female researchers. This activity supports the Agency's "Journey to Self-Reliance" initiative in that developing country participants are engaged and enhancing the skills to conduct, communicate and apply research to inform social, political and economic decisions that will ultimately impact their own development issues.

Objectives for Worldwide: The project aims to complete the following: Preparation of in-depth research and evidence-based reports; Development of easily understood research communication materials like summary reports or evidence-based policy briefs with recommended courses of action for USAID Missions; Support for technical meetings such as expert panels, USAID stakeholder convenings, forums, and other gatherings in which the higher education community plays an important role; Consultations to inform the research activities, monitoring and evaluation plans, and program designs outlined in USAID strategies and Project Appraisal Documents (PADs); Specialized training and advisement around specific technical sectors or issues; Other short-term technical assistance needs as identified by USAID.

description.narrative: USAID Advancing Nutrition is a five-year contract designed by the nutrition team in the Bureau for Global Health, in collaboration with the Bureau for Food Security and the Office of Food for Peace. The objective of the project is to support the implementation of USAIDs Multi-Sectoral Nutrition Strategy 2014-2025 as well as progress toward the Agencys goals of improving nutrition to save lives, build resilience, increase economic productivity and advance development. The purpose of USAID Advancing Nutrition is to strengthen the enabling environment for and support country-led scale-up of effective, integrated and sustainable nutrition-specific and nutrition-sensitive policies, programs/interventions and systems to improve nutritional status and health. This nutrition mechanism is designed to cover a broad range of activities that fall under the following three intermediate results (IRs): IR 1: Equitable provision and utilization of proven, quality nutrition interventions and services at scale IR 2: Country commitment and capacity for multi-sectoral nutrition programming strengthened IR 3: Global learning, evidence and innovative practices generated and applied to nutrition programs

USAID Advancing Nutrition est un contrat de cinq ans conçu par l'équipe de nutrition du Bureau de la santé mondiale, en collaboration avec le Bureau de la sécurité alimentaire et l'Office de l'alimentation pour la paix. L'objectif du projet est de soutenir la mise en œuvre de la stratégie multisectorielle de nutrition de l'USAID 2014-2025 ainsi que les progrès vers les objectifs de l'agence consistant à améliorer la nutrition pour sauver des vies, renforcer la résilience, augmenter la productivité économique et faire progresser le développement. L’objectif de l’USAID Advancing Nutrition est de renforcer l’environnement favorable et de soutenir l’intensification, dirigée par les pays, de politiques, programmes/interventions et systèmes efficaces, intégrés et durables, spécifiques à la nutrition et sensibles à la nutrition, pour améliorer l’état nutritionnel et la santé. Ce mécanisme de nutrition est conçu pour couvrir un large éventail d'activités qui relèvent des trois résultats intermédiaires (RI) suivants : IR 1 : Fourniture et utilisation équitables d'interventions et de services nutritionnels éprouvés et de qualité à grande échelle. IR 2 : Engagement et capacité du pays en matière de programmation nutritionnelle multisectorielle renforcés. IR 3 : Apprentissage mondial, données factuelles et pratiques innovantes générées et appliquées aux programmes de nutrition.

Ce mécanisme de nutrition est conçu pour couvrir un large éventail d'activités qui relèvent des trois résultats intermédiaires (RI) suivants : IR 1 : Fourniture et utilisation équitables d'interventions et de services nutritionnels éprouvés et de qualité à grande échelle. USAID Advancing Nutrition es un contrato de cinco años diseñado por el equipo de nutrición de la Oficina para la Salud Global, en colaboración con la Oficina para la Seguridad Alimentaria y la Oficina de Alimentos para la Paz. El objetivo del proyecto es apoyar la implementación de la Estrategia Multisectorial de Nutrición de USAID 2014-2025, así como el progreso hacia los objetivos de la Agencia de mejorar la nutrición para salvar vidas, generar resiliencia, aumentar la productividad económica y promover el desarrollo. El propósito de USAID Advancing Nutrition es fortalecer el entorno propicio y apoyar la ampliación liderada por los países de políticas, programas/intervenciones y sistemas efectivos, integrados y sostenibles específicos y sensibles a la nutrición para mejorar el estado nutricional y la salud. Este mecanismo de nutrición está diseñado para cubrir una amplia gama de actividades que se enmarcan en los siguientes tres resultados intermedios (RI): RI 1: Provisión y utilización equitativas de intervenciones y servicios de nutrición probados y de calidad a escala RI 2: Fortalecimiento del compromiso y la capacidad del país para la programación multisectorial de nutrición RI 3: Aprendizaje global, evidencia y prácticas innovadoras generadas y aplicadas a los programas de nutrición

USAID Advancing Nutrition é um contrato de cinco anos elaborado pela equipe de nutrição do Bureau for Global Health, em colaboração com o Bureau for Food Security e o Office of Food for Peace. O objectivo do projecto é apoiar a implementação da Estratégia Multissetorial de Nutrição da USAID 2014-2025, bem como o progresso em direção aos objetivos da Agência de melhorar a nutrição para salvar vidas, criar resiliência, aumentar a produtividade económica e promover o desenvolvimento. O objectivo da USAID Advancing Nutrition é fortalecer o ambiente favorável e apoiar a expansão liderada pelos países de políticas, programas/intervenções e sistemas eficazes, integrados e sustentáveis ​​específicos da nutrição e sensíveis à nutrição para melhorar o estado nutricional e a saúde. Este mecanismo de nutrição foi concebido para cobrir uma ampla gama de atividades que se enquadram nos seguintes três resultados intermédios (RI): RI 1: Fornecimento e utilização equitativos de intervenções e serviços nutricionais comprovados e de qualidade em escala RI 2: Compromisso e capacidade dos países para programas de nutrição multissetoriais reforçados RI 3: Aprendizagem global, evidências e práticas inovadoras geradas e aplicadas a programas de nutrição

title.narrative: I-Applied Innovation and Acceleration - Challenges and Prizes

description.narrative: (LAB - Global Development Lab): Challenges and Prizes seeks to remove critical barriers to international development and facilitate creative approaches based in science and technology that promote economic development. The program encourages a wide array of innovators and entrepreneurs to develop sustainable, effective solutions to some of the most challenging development problems of our time. Challenges and Prizes collaborates with other USAID Missions and Bureaus as well as other funders and donors to develop and implement open innovation programs including Grand Challenges for Development and various ad-hoc challenge programs such as WomenConnect as well as prize competitions designed to incentivize specific innovative outcomes such as the Off-Grid Refrigeration Competition and the Desal Prize..

description.narrative: The goal of MTaPS is to enable low- and middle-income countries to strengthen their pharmaceutical systems to ensure sustainable access to and appropriate use of safe, effective, quality-assured, and affordable essential medical products and medicines-related pharmaceutical services. The purpose of MTaPS is to provide pharmaceutical system strengthening assistance for sustained improvements in health system performance, and to advance USAID s goals of Preventing Child and Maternal Deaths, Controlling the HIV/AIDS Epidemic, and Combatting Infectious Disease Threats, as well as expanding essential health coverage. MTaPS works to strengthen essential areas of the pharmaceutical sector, including regulatory capacity, supply chain management, pharmaceutical financing and services, and pharmaceutical management information systems. Within this context, MTaPS addresses USG priority health elements including malaria, HIV/AIDS, family planning and reproductive health, tuberculosis, maternal and child health, neglected tropical diseases, and the Global Health Security Agenda (GHSA). MTaPS focuses on enhancing pharmaceutical services through patient-centered solutions while continuing to support essential supply chain functions and medical products supply security. The MTaPS result areas address the five health systems components (governance, human resources, information, financing, and service delivery) as they pertain to pharmaceutical management, informing the design of potential interventions to ensure that they respond to health element and cross-cutting concerns in support of health system strengthening.

L’objectif du MTaPS est de permettre aux pays à revenu faible ou intermédiaire de renforcer leurs systèmes pharmaceutiques afin de garantir un accès durable et une utilisation appropriée à des produits médicaux essentiels et à des services pharmaceutiques liés aux médicaments sûrs, efficaces, de qualité garantie et abordables. L'objectif du MTaPS est de fournir une assistance au renforcement du système pharmaceutique pour des améliorations durables de la performance du système de santé et de faire progresser les objectifs de l'USAID en matière de prévention des décès infantiles et maternels, de contrôle de l'épidémie de VIH/SIDA et de lutte contre les menaces de maladies infectieuses, ainsi que d'étendre la couverture sanitaire essentielle. MTaPS s'efforce de renforcer les domaines essentiels du secteur pharmaceutique, notamment la capacité réglementaire, la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, le financement et les services pharmaceutiques et les systèmes d'information de gestion pharmaceutique. Dans ce contexte, MTaPS aborde les éléments de santé prioritaires du gouvernement américain, notamment le paludisme, le VIH/SIDA, la planification familiale et la santé reproductive, la tuberculose, la santé maternelle et infantile, les maladies tropicales négligées et le programme de sécurité sanitaire mondiale (GHSA). MTaPS se concentre sur l'amélioration des services pharmaceutiques grâce à des solutions centrées sur le patient tout en continuant à soutenir les fonctions essentielles de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la sécurité de l'approvisionnement en produits médicaux. Les domaines de résultats du MTaPS abordent les cinq composantes des systèmes de santé (gouvernance, ressources humaines, information, financement et prestation de services) en ce qui concerne la gestion pharmaceutique, éclairant la conception d'interventions potentielles pour garantir qu'elles répondent aux éléments de santé et aux préoccupations transversales en faveur du renforcement du système de santé.

O objetivo do MTaPS é permitir que os países de baixo e médio rendimento reforcem os seus sistemas farmacêuticos para garantir o acesso sustentável e a utilização adequada de produtos médicos essenciais e serviços farmacêuticos relacionados com medicamentos seguros, eficazes, de qualidade garantida e acessíveis. O objectivo do MTaPS é fornecer assistência ao reforço do sistema farmacêutico para melhorias sustentadas no desempenho do sistema de saúde e promover os objectivos da USAID de Prevenção de Mortes Infantis e Maternas, Controlo da Epidemia de VIH/SIDA e Combate às Ameaças de Doenças Infecciosas, bem como expandir a cobertura essencial de saúde. O MTaPS trabalha para fortalecer áreas essenciais do setor farmacêutico, incluindo capacidade regulatória, gestão da cadeia de abastecimento, financiamento e serviços farmacêuticos e sistemas de informação de gestão farmacêutica. Neste contexto, o MTaPS aborda elementos de saúde prioritários do Governo dos EUA, incluindo a malária, o VIH/SIDA, o planeamento familiar e a saúde reprodutiva, a tuberculose, a saúde materna e infantil, as doenças tropicais negligenciadas e a Agenda Global de Segurança Sanitária (GHSA). MTaPS se concentra em melhorar os serviços farmacêuticos por meio de soluções centradas no paciente, ao mesmo tempo em que continua a apoiar funções essenciais da cadeia de suprimentos e a segurança do fornecimento de produtos médicos. As áreas de resultados do MTaPS abordam os cinco componentes dos sistemas de saúde (governação, recursos humanos, informação, financiamento e prestação de serviços) no que se refere à gestão farmacêutica, informando a concepção de potenciais intervenções para garantir que respondem ao elemento de saúde e às preocupações transversais em apoio ao fortalecimento do sistema de saúde.

description.narrative: (USAID Asia Regional): .When governments and economic actors have sound, effective, transparent, gender-aware, and accountable systems and policies in place, there is an increased ability to achieve broad-based economic growth and improved regional economic connectivity. This activity will improve the policy environment to promote sustainable economic growth and prosperity, improved regional economic cooperation, sound management of institutions, and good governance under the Indo Pacific Strategy and the Indo-Pacific Economic Framework. This activity will foster an enabling environment for smart, sustainable, and clean transportation infrastructure with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and other Southeast Asia countries. This activity will work with local public and private sector partners to ensure local expertise and buy-in. This activity aligns with Administration priorities on climate and inclusive development

title.narrative: Innovation Design and Advisory Services Team
Equipo de Diseño de Innovación y Servicios de Asesoría

description.narrative: The Lab's Innovation Design and Advisory Team (IDA) works in close collaboration with USAID Missions and their public and private sector stakeholders and partners to advance the effective use of innovative design practices and methodologies to achieve their objectives. IDA works to apply, validate and mainstream innovative design, collaboration and adaption throughout the program cycle, from strategy, project and activity design to implementation and learning. Adaption effectively happens when USAID and partners apply learning and make adjustments during implementation.

El Equipo Asesor y de Diseño de Innovación (IDA) del Laboratorio trabaja en estrecha colaboración con las Misiones de USAID y sus partes interesadas y socios de los sectores público y privado para promover el uso efectivo de prácticas y metodologías de diseño innovadoras para lograr sus objetivos. La AIF trabaja para aplicar, validar e incorporar el diseño, la colaboración y la adaptación innovadores a lo largo del ciclo del programa, desde el diseño de estrategias, proyectos y actividades hasta la implementación y el aprendizaje. La adaptación ocurre efectivamente cuando USAID y sus socios aplican el aprendizaje y hacen ajustes durante la implementación.

title.narrative: Central Asia PVE Research into Action (CAPRIA)

description.narrative: The new Central Asia Countering Violent Extremism (CA CVE) program will make two key interventions. The first will use digital and case study data to inform and test pilot interventions. The learning objectives of this intervention are to gain a better understanding of community-level VE risk and resilience factors in the three countries and determine the extent to which digital drivers of risk and resilience are equal to, greater than, or less than real-world factors, particularly among youth...The second, closely linked intervention will apply a public health lens to CVE research and pilot activities in the Kyrgyz Republic. The aim of this intervention is to identify: to what extent is a public health approach to VE effective in identifying risk and prevention factors and interventions that reduce community risk to VE; to what extent do the community characteristics or factors differ in communities where VE has manifested and in communities with an absence of VE; and to what extent do community-level prevention strategies reduce community vulnerability to VE.

description.narrative: The Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS-8) Program assists participating countries in implementing household and facility-based surveys, analyzing data stemming from these surveys, and facilitating use of these data to support evidence-informed decision making. The DHS-8 contract will continue to be USAID's primary implementation mechanism for demographic and health data collection with activities yielding improved tools, methods, partnerships, and technical guidance to collect quality population, health, and nutrition data. Project activities will also increase in-country individual and institutional capacity for identification of data needs and for survey design, management, and data collection to meet those needs. DHS-8 will disseminate program survey data and information through multiple mechanisms including country specific DHS reports, curricula for professionals, peer reviewed journal publications that use DHS data, and the DHS website. These dissemination activities improve the availability of DHS Program survey data and information, advance analysis and synthesis of DHS Program survey data, and improve facilitation of DHS Program data use among stakeholders worldwide. Through the project's capacity building and dissemination activities, DHS-8 will continue to build on past investment and support countries on their transition to self-reliance.

Le programme d'enquêtes démographiques et de santé (EDS-8) aide les pays participants à mettre en œuvre des enquêtes auprès des ménages et des établissements, à analyser les données issues de ces enquêtes et à faciliter l'utilisation de ces données pour soutenir une prise de décision fondée sur des données factuelles. Le contrat DHS-8 continuera d'être le principal mécanisme de mise en œuvre de l'USAID pour la collecte de données démographiques et sanitaires, avec des activités produisant des outils, des méthodes, des partenariats et des conseils techniques améliorés pour collecter des données de qualité sur la population, la santé et la nutrition. Les activités du projet renforceront également la capacité individuelle et institutionnelle du pays à identifier les besoins en données et à concevoir, gérer et collecter des données pour répondre à ces besoins. L'EDS-8 diffusera les données et informations de l'enquête du programme par le biais de multiples mécanismes, notamment les rapports DHS spécifiques aux pays, les programmes d'études destinés aux professionnels, les publications de revues à comité de lecture qui utilisent les données DHS et le site Web de l'EDS. Ces activités de diffusion améliorent la disponibilité des données et des informations d'enquête du programme DHS, font progresser l'analyse et la synthèse des données d'enquête du programme DHS et améliorent la facilitation de l'utilisation des données du programme DHS parmi les parties prenantes du monde entier. Grâce aux activités de renforcement des capacités et de diffusion du projet, l'EDS-8 continuera de s'appuyer sur les investissements passés et de soutenir les pays dans leur transition vers l'autosuffisance.

Le contrat DHS-8 continuera d'être le principal mécanisme de mise en œuvre de l'USAID pour la collecte de données démographiques et sanitaires, avec des activités produisant des outils, des méthodes, des partenariats et des conseils techniques améliorés pour collecter des données de qualité sur la population, la santé et la nutrition. Les activités du projet renforceront également la capacité individuelle et institutionnelle du pays à identifier les besoins en données et à concevoir, gérer et collecter des données pour répondre à ces besoins. L'EDS-8 diffusera les données et informations de l'enquête du programme par le biais de multiples mécanismes, notamment les rapports DHS spécifiques aux pays, les programmes d'études destinés aux professionnels, les publications de revues à comité de lecture qui utilisent les données DHS et le site Web de l'EDS. Ces activités de diffusion améliorent la disponibilité des données et des informations d'enquête du programme DHS, font progresser l'analyse et la synthèse des données d'enquête du programme DHS et améliorent la facilitation de l'utilisation des données du programme DHS parmi les parties prenantes du monde entier. Grâce aux activités de renforcement des capacités et de diffusion du projet, l'EDS-8 continuera de s'appuyer sur les investissements passés et de soutenir les pays dans leur transition vers l'autosuffisance.

El Programa de Encuestas Demográficas y de Salud (DHS-8) ayuda a los países participantes a implementar encuestas de hogares y establecimientos, analizar datos derivados de estas encuestas y facilitar el uso de estos datos para respaldar la toma de decisiones basada en evidencia. El contrato DHS-8 seguirá siendo el principal mecanismo de implementación de USAID para la recopilación de datos demográficos y de salud con actividades que producirán mejores herramientas, métodos, asociaciones y orientación técnica para recopilar datos de calidad sobre población, salud y nutrición. Las actividades del proyecto también aumentarán la capacidad individual e institucional en el país para identificar las necesidades de datos y para el diseño, la gestión y la recopilación de datos de encuestas para satisfacer esas necesidades. DHS-8 difundirá información y datos de encuestas del programa a través de múltiples mecanismos, incluidos informes del DHS específicos de cada país, planes de estudio para profesionales, publicaciones de revistas revisadas por pares que utilizan datos del DHS y el sitio web del DHS. Estas actividades de difusión mejoran la disponibilidad de datos e información de las encuestas del Programa DHS, avanzan el análisis y la síntesis de los datos de las encuestas del Programa DHS y mejoran la facilitación del uso de los datos del Programa DHS entre las partes interesadas en todo el mundo. A través de las actividades de creación de capacidad y difusión del proyecto, el DHS-8 seguirá aprovechando las inversiones anteriores y apoyando a los países en su transición hacia la autosuficiencia.

O Programa de Inquéritos Demográficos e de Saúde (DHS-8) ajuda os países participantes na implementação de inquéritos aos agregados familiares e às instalações, analisando os dados provenientes destes inquéritos e facilitando a utilização destes dados para apoiar a tomada de decisões baseada em evidências. O contrato DHS-8 continuará a ser o principal mecanismo de implementação da USAID para a recolha de dados demográficos e de saúde, com actividades que produzem ferramentas, métodos, parcerias e orientação técnica melhorados para recolher dados de qualidade sobre população, saúde e nutrição. As actividades do projecto também aumentarão a capacidade individual e institucional do país para a identificação de necessidades de dados e para a concepção, gestão e recolha de dados de inquéritos para satisfazer essas necessidades. O DHS-8 divulgará dados e informações de pesquisas do programa através de múltiplos mecanismos, incluindo relatórios do DHS específicos de cada país, currículos para profissionais, publicações em periódicos revisados ​​por pares que utilizam dados do DHS e o website do DHS. Estas actividades de divulgação melhoram a disponibilidade dos dados e informações dos inquéritos do Programa DHS, avançam a análise e síntese dos dados dos inquéritos do Programa DHS e melhoram a facilitação da utilização dos dados do Programa DHS entre as partes interessadas em todo o mundo. Através das atividades de capacitação e divulgação do projeto, o DHS-8 continuará a aproveitar os investimentos anteriores e a apoiar os países na sua transição para a autossuficiência.

description.narrative: The Artisanal Mining and Property Rights (AMPR) activity will improve land and resource governance and promote responsible supply chains for minerals to mitigate against conflict, reduce flows into illicit financial networks, improve economic livelihoods and self-reliance for poor artisanal mining communities, support sustainable environmental practices, increase revenues from artisanal and small scale mining, and promote social cohesion, key U.S. Government goals. Among other activities, this activity will help establish and improve artisanal mining policies and laws, address alternative livelihoods and land use planning, provide training at the local and national levels, and work with artisanal and small scale mining stakeholders at all levels - from local communities to international fora. This activity will adopt a gender sensitive and multidisciplinary approach to address the development challenges associated with informal artisanal and small scale mining.

description.narrative: This program supports the Mission's goal for an independent, prosperous, and healthy Ukraine united around core European values in one or more of the following sectors: strengthening of democratic governance, and more inclusive, sustainable, market-driven economic growth.

title.narrative: Feed the Future Innovation Lab for Peanut Research (PRIL)
Nourrir le futur laboratoire d'innovation pour la recherche sur l'arachide (PRIL)

description.narrative: Purpose: To conduct research on productivity and profitability of peanuts in diversified productions systems. As part of the suite of Feed the Future Innovation Labs, the program draws on the expertise of US universities and developing country research institutions to address the GFSS goal of reducing global hunger, malnutrition, and poverty. Activities: Research across the biophysical and social sciences on peanuts with a global program scope in the following areas of the peanut production and value chain cycle: 1) improved peanut varieties; 2) increased nutrition understanding (dietary diversity, food security, and therapeutic or supplementary foods); 3) increased understanding of preferences, needs, and priorities along the peanut value chain by gender, age group, or other disadvantaged groups, and application of that understanding to project design and implementation; and 4) increased and inclusive value-added gains along the value chain.

Objectif : Mener des recherches sur la productivité et la rentabilité de l’arachide dans des systèmes de production diversifiés. Dans le cadre de la série Feed the Future Innovation Labs, le programme s'appuie sur l'expertise des universités américaines et des instituts de recherche des pays en développement pour atteindre l'objectif du GFSS consistant à réduire la faim, la malnutrition et la pauvreté dans le monde. Activités : Recherche en sciences biophysiques et sociales sur l'arachide avec une portée de programme mondiale dans les domaines suivants du cycle de production et de la chaîne de valeur de l'arachide : 1) variétés d'arachide améliorées ; 2) une meilleure compréhension de la nutrition (diversité alimentaire, sécurité alimentaire et aliments thérapeutiques ou complémentaires) ; 3) une meilleure compréhension des préférences, des besoins et des priorités tout au long de la chaîne de valeur de l'arachide par sexe, groupe d'âge ou autres groupes défavorisés, et l'application de cette compréhension à la conception et à la mise en œuvre des projets ; et 4) des gains de valeur ajoutée accrus et inclusifs tout au long de la chaîne de valeur.

title.narrative: Long-term Assistance and Services for Research (LASER)
Asistencia y Servicios a Largo Plazo para la Investigación (LASER)
Asistencia y Servicios a Largo Plazo para la Investigación (LASER)

description.narrative: Long-term Assistance and Services for Research (LASER) will leverage and support international university networks, inclusive of universities from both the United States (U.S) and lower-middle income countries (LMIC), to undertake novel and innovative development research, collaborate with Missions and local actors to design and undertake research projects, and create connections that accelerate the uptake of research outputs by development actors and policy makers. The resulting LASER network will not only generate new knowledge for USAID, but also initiate long term, sustainable collaborations between U.S. and developing country institutions that are characterized by equitable university partnerships. Services this mechanism will provide: Co-creation and implementation of research activitiesResearch design, primary data collection and analysis; Technical reports with potential for USAID co-authorshipTranslation of research findings into policy and program relevant recommendations; Academic-style program evaluation (answers a sector relevant, hypothesis-driven question); Sustained engagement with research faculty.

La Asistencia y Servicios a Largo Plazo para la Investigación (LASER) aprovechará y apoyará las redes universitarias internacionales, incluidas universidades de los Estados Unidos (EE. UU.) y de países de ingresos medianos bajos (PIBM), para llevar a cabo investigaciones de desarrollo novedosas e innovadoras, colaborar con las Misiones y actores locales para diseñar y emprender proyectos de investigación, y crear conexiones que aceleren la adopción de los resultados de la investigación por parte de los actores del desarrollo y los formuladores de políticas. La red LASER resultante no solo generará nuevos conocimientos para USAID, sino que también iniciará colaboraciones sostenibles a largo plazo entre instituciones estadounidenses y de países en desarrollo que se caracterizan por asociaciones universitarias equitativas. Servicios que brindará este mecanismo: Cocreación e implementación de actividades de investigación Diseño de investigaciones, recolección y análisis de datos primarios; Informes técnicos con potencial para coautoría de USAID. Traducción de los resultados de la investigación en recomendaciones relevantes para políticas y programas; Evaluación de programas de estilo académico (responde a una pregunta relevante para el sector, basada en hipótesis); Compromiso sostenido con el profesorado de investigación.

La Asistencia y Servicios a Largo Plazo para la Investigación (LASER) aprovechará y apoyará las redes universitarias internacionales, incluidas universidades de los Estados Unidos (EE. UU.) y de países de ingresos medianos bajos (PIBM), para llevar a cabo investigaciones de desarrollo novedosas e innovadoras, colaborar con las Misiones y actores locales para diseñar y emprender proyectos de investigación, y crear conexiones que aceleren la adopción de los resultados de la investigación por parte de los actores del desarrollo y los formuladores de políticas. La red LASER resultante no solo generará nuevos conocimientos para USAID, sino que también iniciará colaboraciones sostenibles a largo plazo entre instituciones estadounidenses y de países en desarrollo que se caracterizan por asociaciones universitarias equitativas. Servicios que brindará este mecanismo: Cocreación e implementación de actividades de investigación Diseño de investigaciones, recolección y análisis de datos primarios; Informes técnicos con potencial para coautoría de USAID. Traducción de los resultados de la investigación en recomendaciones relevantes para políticas y programas; Evaluación de programas de estilo académico (responde a una pregunta relevante para el sector, basada en hipótesis); Compromiso sostenido con el profesorado de investigación.

Objectives for Worldwide: The project aims to complete the following: Help USAID and others identify and refine research needs; Co-create and implement research activities.oResearch design, primary data collection, and analysis; Produce technical reports with potential for USAID co-authorship; Translate research findings into policy and program relevant recommendations; Conduct academic-style program evaluation (hypothesis-driven evaluation question); Foster sustained research partnerships with USAID M/B/IOs, host-country universities,governments, or other organizations.

title.narrative: S-Higher Education Solution Network (HESN)/ APS - Vanderbilt University Medical Center

description.narrative: (LAB - Global Development Lab): Through the STIP Annual Program Statement (APS), the Lab published an APS aimed at identifying and funding university-based support of cross-cutting development challenges that can be tackled by a "whole of university" approach with our U.S. based and non-U.S. based university partners. Launched in March 2018, the Accelerating Local Potential Addenda to the STIP APS sought to build human and institutional capacity in developing country universities through partnerships with U.S. based universities. After co-creation, four awards were selected that each sought to build capacity and self-reliance by strengthening developing country university institutions. One of the four awards is with the Vanderbilt University. With FY 2018 funding, Vanderbilt University Medical Center and its partners Moi University, Purdue University, Aga Khan University, Verve K.O, and Kenya Ministry of Health are implementing the Higher Education Partnership for Innovation and Sustainable Biomedical Informatics Capacity in Kenya (PISBIC Kenya). PISBIC Kenya is working to sustainably strengthen education, research, and innovation capacity in health informatics in Kenya and across the region.

title.narrative: S-Higher Education Solution Network (HESN)/ APS - Michigan State University

description.narrative: (LAB - Global Development Lab): Through the STIP Annual Program Statement (APS), the Lab published an APS aimed at identifying and funding university-based support of cross-cutting development challenges that can be tackled by a "whole of university" approach with our U.S. based and non-U.S. based university partners. Launched in March 2018, the Accelerating Local Potential Addenda to the STIP APS sought to build human and institutional capacity in developing country universities through partnerships with U.S. based universities. After co-creation, four awards were selected that each sought to build capacity and self-reliance by strengthening developing country university institutions. One of the four awards is with Michigan State University. Michigan State University, in partnership with Lilongwe University of Agriculture and Natural Resources, Malawi University of Science and Technology (MUST) and the Malawi National Engineering Ecosystem Network, plan to implement the MUST Innovation Scholars Program (MUST ISP). The MUST ISP aims to improve the human and institutional capacity of MUST to harness and use innovation to respond to, and preempt, local and regional agricultural challenges, as well as strengthen relationships among academia, the private sector and the Malawian government to maximize potential use of agricultural innovations stemming from MUST (and other Malawian universities).

title.narrative: Cooperative Development Program (CDP) - National Cooperative Business Association CLUSA International
Programa de Desarrollo Cooperativo (CDP) - Asociación Nacional Empresarial Cooperativa CLUSA Internacional

description.narrative: Through the CDP APS mechanism and in support of locally-led development, E3/LS will provide funding to NCBA CLUSA to implement cooperative development activities in Peru, Madagascar, Guatemala, Kenya, and Tanzania. Specifically, NCBA CLUSA will improve enabling environments and cooperative systems, and build capacity of local cooperatives and apex associations to better meet the evolving needs of their members. Additionally, NCBA CLUSA will also work with local cooperatives to develop capitalization strategies to increase member equity and thereby member engagement and patronage for improved performance. These field-based activities build the capacity of local, democratic institutions and advance the Agency's objectives of local resource mobilization and self-reliance.

A través del mecanismo CDP APS y en apoyo del desarrollo liderado localmente, E3/LS proporcionará financiamiento a NCBA CLUSA para implementar actividades de desarrollo cooperativo en Perú, Madagascar, Guatemala, Kenia y Tanzania. Específicamente, NCBA CLUSA mejorará los entornos propicios y los sistemas cooperativos, y desarrollará la capacidad de las cooperativas locales y las asociaciones principales para satisfacer mejor las necesidades cambiantes de sus miembros. Además, NCBA CLUSA también trabajará con cooperativas locales para desarrollar estrategias de capitalización para aumentar el capital de los miembros y, por lo tanto, la participación y el patrocinio de los miembros para mejorar el desempeño. Estas actividades sobre el terreno fortalecen la capacidad de las instituciones democráticas locales y promueven los objetivos de la Agencia de movilización de recursos locales y autosuficiencia.

title.narrative: Accélérateur de renforcement des systèmes de santé (HSSA)
Accélérateur de renforcement des systèmes de santé (HSSA)
Accélérateur de renforcement des systèmes de santé (HSSA)

description.narrative: The Health Systems Strengthening Accelerator (HSSA) is a 5-year global project. It will provide a global platform to connect locally-driven health system innovations with global knowledge, accelerate countries' journeys to self-reliant health systems, and improve the institutional architecture for evidence-based and sustainable health system strengthening. This project will address persistent health systems problems at the local and global levels through understanding of problems and root causes; evidence translation; innovation and iterative adaptation; understanding of motivation, incentives, and political dynamics; and focusing on institutionalization and sustainability.

L’Accélérateur de renforcement des systèmes de santé (HSSA) est un projet mondial de 5 ans. Il fournira une plate-forme mondiale pour relier les innovations des systèmes de santé d'origine locale aux connaissances mondiales, accélérera le parcours des pays vers des systèmes de santé autonomes et améliorera l'architecture institutionnelle pour un renforcement durable et fondé sur des données probantes. Ce projet s'attaquera aux problèmes persistants des systèmes de santé aux niveaux local et mondial grâce à la compréhension des problèmes et de leurs causes profondes ; traduction de preuves; innovation et adaptation itérative ; compréhension de la motivation, des incitations et de la dynamique politique ; et se concentrer sur l'institutionnalisation et la durabilité.

title.narrative: Developing Acute Care and Emergency Referral Systems(ACERS)

description.narrative: The Developing Acute Care and Emergency Referral Systems Project assesses the added value of a program of implementation research, action, and capacity building to timely care-seeking behavior and effective referrals to improve maternal and neonatal care in two regions of Ghana. Project efforts build off the Three Delay Model, with a focus on the second and third delay for obstetric and neonatal emergencies. Ghana continues to experience high maternal and neonatal mortality rates despite a well-organized, decentralized system of health care. Additionally, the lack of policies and guidelines for comprehensive care at the district level have resulted in emergency care and referral initiatives that are not well-coordinated and have unknown efficacy and impact. The ACERS project will augment the Community-based Health Planning and Services (CHPS) platform with activities around acute care and emergency referral systems from the community to the district level, seeking to prove that separate components of care can be assembled into a sustainable single system with scale-up capabilities. ACERS will be woven into the fabric of Ghana s regional, district, and community health system structures to ensure the implementation of a sustainable and scalable model. This implementation research effort, co-managed and co-financed by USAID Ghana, supports the Government of Ghana s vision of improved service delivery and progress towards self-reliance.

title.narrative: Kampala Slum Maternal and Newborn Project (Kampala MaNe)

description.narrative: (USAID Global Health (GH)): <!--br {mso-data-placement:same-cell;}-->The purpose of the MaNe project is to support implementation research to test an innovative and promising package of interventions to address the demand and supply side barriers affecting care-seeking, effective referrals and provision of quality care equitably for better maternal and newborn health (MNH) outcomes in urban slum settings in Kampala city. The intervention to be tested includes: i) Harnessing the mixed health care system in Kampala to address the needs of the urban poor; ii) Improving illness recognition and care- seeking among poor urban women using social networks and social media platforms; and iii) Strengthening the referral linkages between health facilities and ensuring available emergency transport to increase access to critical health services.

title.narrative: Enabling and Protecting Civic Space (EPCS) Illuminating New Solutions and Programmatic Innovations for Resilient Spaces (INSPIRES) project
Proyecto Habilitación y protección del espacio cívico (EPCS) Iluminando nuevas soluciones e innovaciones programáticas para espacios resilientes (INSPIRES).

description.narrative: The Enabling and Protecting Civic Space (EPCS) Illuminating New Solutions and Programmatic Innovations for Resilient Spaces (INSPIRES) project will increase knowledge and capacity to respond to growing restrictions on democratic freedoms of association, assembly, and expression around the world. With civic space shifting rapidly around the globe, faster and more potent interventions are critical for bolstering local civil societies. Many current best practices have been developed through a series of ad hoc responses to closures of civic and political space. Through in-depth research, earlier forecasting of civic space shifts, and rigorous evaluation of different interventions, civil society can be better supported to navigate and influence these shifts in proactive, effective, and strategic ways.

El proyecto Habilitación y Protección del Espacio Cívico (EPCS), Iluminando Nuevas Soluciones e Innovaciones Programáticas para Espacios Resilientes (INSPIRES), aumentará el conocimiento y la capacidad para responder a las crecientes restricciones a las libertades democráticas de asociación, reunión y expresión en todo el mundo. Dado que el espacio cívico está cambiando rápidamente en todo el mundo, es fundamental realizar intervenciones más rápidas y potentes para fortalecer las sociedades civiles locales. Muchas de las mejores prácticas actuales se han desarrollado a través de una serie de respuestas ad hoc a los cierres del espacio cívico y político. A través de una investigación en profundidad, una previsión temprana de los cambios en el espacio cívico y una evaluación rigurosa de diferentes intervenciones, se puede apoyar mejor a la sociedad civil para navegar e influir en estos cambios de manera proactiva, efectiva y estratégica.

title.narrative: DRG - Regional LWA-Asia: Asia-Pacific Regional Support for Elections and Political Transitions

description.narrative: (USAID Democracy, Conflict and Humanitarian Assistance (DCHA)): .This mechanism will support improved election integrity and electoral justice in the Asia and Pacific region. With a qualified local organization delivering these services on a regional scale, USAID seeks to expand and diversify the base of organizations with which Missions can partner on electoral support programming and to increase the sustainability of development assistance in the elections and political transitions (EPT) arena. The award will provide USAID missions in Asia with a pre-competed mechanism for swift design and start-up of EPT programs. The award will strengthen elections and political processes in Asia through technical support and knowledge exchange among partner countries. During the program, national and local elections are anticipated in several countries in the region, and implementer Perludem will conduct targeted activities in selected countries to be determined depending on the political context and timing of these elections. Regional expertise will be shared through the country-specific activities and though regional workshops with electoral stakeholders. Perludem will develop and maintain an online database of election-related materials and regional EPT experts. To respond effectively to the rapidly evolving political environment in the region, the award will also include a Quick Response Fund to address emerging opportunities for engagement and programming. Fiscal year 2019 funds will support regional technical leadership, which may include work on regional standards for election administration and oversight. The award supports USAID priorities by providing electoral assistance to foster greater government accountability in partner countries. The emphasis on learning and information sharing will strengthen the effectiveness and sustainability of U.S. development investments, helping to ensure effectiveness and accountability to U.S. taxpayers, in line with the State-USAID

title.narrative: Professional and Institutional Capacities of Media

description.narrative: Boost the capacity and sustainability of professional journalism and citizen-generated media through a mix of training, education, mentoring, networking and exchange activities, including but not limited to: content production support as a training mechanism; developing and distributing training materials; and building and/or reforming media-related host country training and higher educational institutions. Support the development of a financially sustainable media sector through organizational and financial management training, advertising sector development, audience research and/or circulation audit capacities, market research, business planning, capital infusion and loans, media industry information exchanges, sponsorships/partnerships and other methods to improve the economic viability of the sector.

title.narrative: ID: Changing the Way we Care GDA (CTWWC)

description.narrative: (USAID Bureau for Inclusive Growth, Partnerships, and Innovation (IPI)): This activity addresses the issue of children living outside of family care by strengthening government systems to identify vulnerable children and place them in safe family care settings. With FY 2024 funds, the activity will continue to work with families and communities to prevent unnecessary separation and promote global efforts to shift from residential and institutional care to a family-based care model. This activity contributes to the U.S. government's Advancing Protection and Care for Children in Adversity (Thrive) strategy and helps ensure that the U.S. government's investments for the most vulnerable children are comprehensive, coordinated, and effective in helping countries sustainably finance, manage, and deliver services that lead to strong families and communities. This IM implements the Vulnerable Children directive/earmark.

title.narrative: Governança Integrada de Terras e Recursos (ILRG)

description.narrative: The Integrated Land and Resource Governance (ILRG) activity will work to remove tenure-related barriers and improve land and resource governance to achieve development objectives in support of U.S. national interests such as conflict prevention and mitigation, countering violent extremism, achieving women's economic empowerment, promoting self-reliance and inclusive economic growth, increasing agricultural productivity and food security, climate change, and strengthening biodiversity conservation and natural resources management. ILRG seeks to: Support the development of inclusive land and property rights laws and policies; Assist law and policy implementation, including clarifying, documenting, registering, and administering rights to land and resources; Support the capacity of local institutions to administer and secure equitable land and resource governance; and Facilitate responsible land-based investments with businesses to strengthen value chains, enhance resilient societies, and increase local development ownership. The specific activities under ILRG are still under development.

A actividade de Governação Integrada de Terras e Recursos (ILRG) trabalhará para remover barreiras relacionadas com a posse e melhorar a governação de terras e recursos para alcançar objectivos de desenvolvimento em apoio aos interesses nacionais dos EUA, tais como prevenção e mitigação de conflitos, combate ao extremismo violento, alcançar o empoderamento económico das mulheres, promover a auto-suficiência e o crescimento económico inclusivo, aumentar a produtividade agrícola e a segurança alimentar, as alterações climáticas e reforçar a conservação da biodiversidade e a gestão dos recursos naturais. A ILRG procura: Apoiar o desenvolvimento de leis e políticas inclusivas sobre direitos fundiários e de propriedade; Auxiliar na implementação de leis e políticas, incluindo esclarecer, documentar, registrar e administrar direitos à terra e aos recursos; Apoiar a capacidade das instituições locais para administrar e garantir uma governação equitativa de terras e recursos; e Facilitar investimentos responsáveis ​​baseados em terras com empresas para fortalecer cadeias de valor, melhorar sociedades resilientes e aumentar a apropriação do desenvolvimento local. As atividades específicas no âmbito da ILRG ainda estão em desenvolvimento.

title.narrative: Rajasthan Maternal and New-born Health (MNH) Impact Bond

description.narrative: The Rajasthan Maternal and New-born Health (MNH) Impact Bond is an innovative results-based financing mechanism that will use private investor capital to fund interventions aimed at improving maternal and new-born health in the state of Rajasthan, India. Specifically, the Development Impact Bond (DIB) will support the preparation for accreditation to national standards of private sector small health-care organizations (SHCOs) in Rajasthan. Achievement of the accreditation will result in better quality care, and in turn this is expected to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality. The DIB aims to prepare at least 360 SHCOs to apply for a combined quality certification from the Federation of Obstetrics and Gynaecological Societies of India (FOGSI) and the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals and Healthcare Providers (NABH).

title.narrative: Regional Elections and Political Processes II

description.narrative: REAPPS Phase 2 focuses on developing and strengthening democratic leadership skills among politically active young people from political parties and civil society across the democratic spectrum; increasing government oversight, political participation, as well as the institutional and public resilience to anti-democratic influences; and strengthening election administration leadership and effectiveness. The overall goal of this regional program is to promote cross-border learning and networking on a wide range of existing initiatives on, and to develop new capacity in political participation, government transparency, and election administration. In line with USAID's Political Process Assistance Policy, USAID will ensure activities support representative, multiparty systems and do not seek to determine election outcomes. REAPPS II has three objectives: Objective 1, Political Leadership Development, the activity focuses on creation of the European Democracy Youth Network; Objective 2, Government Oversight and Political Participation; and finally, Objective 3, Election Administration, which will focus on strengthening the leadership, integrity, and institutional independence of election management bodies. CEPPS' proposed geographic scope for all three objectives is the Balkans region and FSU countries participating in the EU's Eastern Partnership.

title.narrative: TB Data, Impact Assessment, and Communications Hub (TB DIAH)

description.narrative: The TB Data, Impact Assessment, and Communications Hub (TB DIAH) project is designed to improve the use of data for decision-making. Improved analysis of TB data will enable USAID, national TB programs (NTPs), and other key national and global stakeholders to support the planning for, and effective implementation of, TB interventions.

description.narrative: The USAID-funded Data for Impact (D4I) project is a mechanism for monitoring, evaluation, data analysis and use, and other research needs. D4I is an associate award of the MEASURE Evaluation Phase IV project and is a cross-bureau global health mechanism that supports Missions across health sectors. D4I builds on and reinforces current U.S. government efforts to support countries to generate and use high quality data as evidence to improve programs, policies, and outcomes (https://www.data4impactproject.org). D4I will continue the work of MEASURE Evaluation Phase IV around evaluation, data quality and data use (the specific services are listed below) through the adaptation and use of tools and methodologies developed by MEASURE Evaluation Phase IV and through development of new ones as needed.

Le projet Data for Impact (D4I), financé par l'USAID, est un mécanisme de suivi, d'évaluation, d'analyse et d'utilisation des données, ainsi que d'autres besoins de recherche. D4I est un prix associé du projet MEASURE Evaluation Phase IV et est un mécanisme de santé mondial inter-bureaux qui soutient les missions dans tous les secteurs de la santé. D4I s'appuie et renforce les efforts actuels du gouvernement américain pour aider les pays à générer et à utiliser des données de haute qualité comme preuves pour améliorer les programmes, les politiques et les résultats (https://www.data4impactproject.org). D4I poursuivra le travail de MEASURE Evaluation Phase IV autour de l'évaluation, de la qualité et de l'utilisation des données (les services spécifiques sont répertoriés ci-dessous) à travers l'adaptation et l'utilisation d'outils et de méthodologies développés par MEASURE Evaluation Phase IV et par le développement de nouveaux si nécessaire.

description.narrative: USAID's efforts to combat wildlife trafficking are often weakened or undermined by corruption. This new activity aims to bring cutting-edge expertise to bear on this challenge, assisting global and country-level programs to develop and promote best practices and tools to tackle corruption, including direct assistance to mission and partner staff specific to local conditions and the interventions being applied. Solutions may include: changing incentive structures to deter corrupt behavior; making government processes more transparent; and promoting monitoring and accountability by the public and the media.

title.narrative: Feed the Future Innovation Lab for Legume Systems Research
Nourrir le futur laboratoire d'innovation pour la recherche sur les systèmes de légumineuses

description.narrative: Purpose: The Legume Systems Research Innovation Lab will develop and evaluate technologies and options for utilizing legumes in agricultural and food systems leading to sustainably intensified smallholder farming systems and improved resilience and nutritional outcomes. Activities: The research portfolio will address integration of legumes into agricultural landscapes in such a way as to increase farm productivity, promote environmental sustainability, restore soil fertility, increase adaptation to variable and changing weather patterns, and stabilize yields for smallholders; evaluate and develop a role for legumes in local/regional market systems in such a way as to increase the diversity and profitability of agricultural income opportunities for smallholders; and conduct analysis of sociocultural and/or economic motivators or barriers to legume utilization at various stages within the market systems.

Objectif : Le laboratoire d'innovation de recherche sur les systèmes de légumineuses développera et évaluera des technologies et des options pour l'utilisation des légumineuses dans les systèmes agricoles et alimentaires, conduisant à des systèmes agricoles de petits exploitants intensifiés de manière durable et à une résilience et des résultats nutritionnels améliorés. Activités : Le portefeuille de recherche portera sur l'intégration des légumineuses dans les paysages agricoles de manière à accroître la productivité agricole, à promouvoir la durabilité environnementale, à restaurer la fertilité des sols, à accroître l'adaptation aux conditions météorologiques variables et changeantes et à stabiliser les rendements des petits exploitants ; évaluer et développer le rôle des légumineuses dans les systèmes de marché locaux/régionaux de manière à accroître la diversité et la rentabilité des opportunités de revenus agricoles pour les petits exploitants ; et mener une analyse des facteurs de motivation ou des obstacles socioculturels et/ou économiques à l'utilisation des légumineuses à différentes étapes des systèmes de marché.
